services.title: NRI Tax Filing
services.description: Simplify NRI tax filing and ensure full compliance with Indian laws while maximizing available benefits.
services.content:
Managing taxes from abroad can be complex. At LDR GROUPS, we simplify NRI tax filing and ensure full compliance with Indian laws while maximizing benefits available under the Income Tax Act.

Why Do NRIs Need to File Returns in India?
NRIs are required to file tax returns in India if they:
• Earn income in India above ₹2.5 lakh in a financial year.
• Have capital gains from property, shares, or mutual funds.
• Wish to claim a refund of excess TDS deducted.

What Income is Taxable for NRIs?
NRIs are taxed only on income earned or received in India, such as:
• Salary received in India.
• Rental income from house property.
• Interest on NRO deposits and securities.
• Capital gains on sale of property, shares, or investments.
• Income earned outside India is not taxable for NRIs.

Benefits & Deductions Available
• Tax relief under DTAA (Double Taxation Avoidance Agreement).
• Deductions under 80C, 80D, 80E, Section 24(b), etc.
• Tax-free interest on NRE and FCNR deposits.
• Lower/Nil TDS certificate assistance to reduce upfront tax liability.

How We Help
✅ Assess your residential status and tax liability.
✅ Compute income & apply eligible deductions.
✅ Optimize tax exposure with DTAA benefits.
✅ File the right ITR (ITR-2/3) on time.
✅ Assist in TDS refund claims & repatriation of funds abroad.

Why Choose Us?
• Expertise in NRI taxation with years of experience.
• End-to-end support – from tax planning to compliance.
• Hassle-free filing with maximum refund optimization.
• Quick turnaround and reliable advisory.

Simplify your NRI tax filing with expert guidance.

services.title: Property Taxation for NRIs
services.description: Complete property taxation services for NRIs to ensure compliance while optimizing tax efficiency.
services.content:
Owning property in India is one of the most common forms of investment by NRIs. However, taxation on property income, sale, and repatriation of funds involves complex rules under the Income Tax Act and FEMA regulations. At LDR GROUPS, we provide complete property taxation services for NRIs to ensure compliance while optimizing tax efficiency.

Key Aspects of NRI Property Taxation

Rental Income
• Rental income from property in India is taxable in India, irrespective of NRI's residential status.
• Standard deduction of 30%, municipal taxes, and home loan interest are allowed.
• TDS @ 30% is deducted by the tenant while paying rent to an NRI.

Capital Gains on Sale of Property
• Short-Term Capital Gains (STCG): Taxed at applicable slab rates if property is sold within 24 months of purchase.
• Long-Term Capital Gains (LTCG): Taxed at 20% with indexation after 24 months.
• Benefits under Section 54/54EC/54F available for reinvestment in property or specified bonds.

Repatriation of Sale Proceeds
• Funds can be repatriated outside India through NRO accounts after tax clearance.
• Requires Form 15CA/15CB certification for remittance.

Wealth & Inheritance Aspects
• No wealth tax in India.
• Inherited property is not taxed at the time of inheritance, but taxation arises when sold.

Our Services for NRIs
• Computation of rental income and tax filing.
• Guidance on capital gains tax and reinvestment planning.
• Assistance in obtaining Lower/Nil TDS Certificates.
• FEMA & RBI compliance for repatriation of funds.
• End-to-end documentation (Form 15CA/15CB, TDS compliance, DSC filing).
• Advisory on DTAA benefits to avoid double taxation.

Why Choose Us?
• Specialized expertise in NRI property taxation.
• One-stop solution covering income tax + FEMA compliance.
• Quick repatriation support with error-free certifications.
• Strategic tax planning to minimize liabilities.

services.title: Resident Director Services
services.description: Resident Director Services to ensure smooth company incorporation and ongoing compliance for foreign companies.
services.content:
According to the Companies Act, 2013, every company incorporated in India must have at least one Resident Director — a person who has stayed in India for a minimum of 182 days during the previous calendar year. For foreign companies and startups entering India, fulfilling this requirement can be challenging.
At LDR GROUPS, we provide Resident Director Services to ensure smooth company incorporation and ongoing compliance, helping foreign investors and businesses establish their presence in India seamlessly.

Why Resident Director Services?
• Mandatory requirement under Indian corporate law.
• Ensures valid company incorporation and ROC compliance.
• Facilitates smooth communication with regulatory authorities.
• Helps foreign companies operate without delays or legal hurdles.

Our Resident Director Services
We provide end-to-end assistance with:
• Appointing a qualified Resident Director in compliance with Indian laws.
• Ensuring statutory compliance with ROC and regulatory authorities.
• Maintaining confidentiality & integrity of company affairs.
• Support in Board Meetings & Filings – Signing necessary forms, resolutions, and documents.
• Liaison with Authorities – Assisting in communication with banks, ROC, and government bodies.
• Corporate Governance Oversight – Ensuring the company operates within legal frameworks.

Why Choose Us?
• Experienced panel of professionals available as Resident Directors.
• Complete confidentiality and professionalism in handling company matters.
• Support not just for incorporation, but also for ongoing compliance and governance.
• One-stop solution covering company formation, taxation, FEMA, and compliance for foreign businesses.
